set.webhooks.help: Your own HTTPS endpoint receives a signed JSON message when records, zones, DNSSEC or DynDNS change – with retries and a delivery log.
set.webhooks.infoBody: The server sends a POST with a JSON body. Verify it with the shared secret: compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body and compare it with the value after sha256= in the X-DNS-Manager-Signature header. Failed deliveries are retried up to 6 times; the X-DNS-Manager-Delivery header stays the same – use it to detect duplicates.
set.webhooks.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate webhook “{{name}}”? Pending deliveries will be discarded.
set.webhooks.rotateConfirm: Generate a new secret for “{{name}}”? The old secret stops working immediately – update the receiver.
set.webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete webhook “{{name}}” and its delivery log?
set.webhooks.secretUnreadable: The secret cannot be read (key changed?). Please rotate the secret and update the receiver.
set.webhooks.urlUnreadable: The stored target URL cannot be read (key changed?). Nothing is delivered until you enter the URL again.
set.webhooks.urlUnreadableEdit: The stored URL cannot be read – please enter the target URL again.
set.webhooks.workerDisabled: Delivery is switched off on this server (BACKGROUND_WORKERS_ENABLED=false). Events are collected but not sent.
set.webhooks.workerNotRunning: The delivery service is not running. Please inform your administrator (check the container log).
set.webhooks.nameHint: Your own name to recognise it (e.g. “Slack” or “CI”).
set.webhooks.urlHint: https:// (recommended) or http:// – must be reachable from this server. Private and internal addresses are blocked.
set.webhooks.eventsHint: Choose which events are sent. Fewer events = less noise. Payload details are in the docs (Webhooks).
set.webhooks.scopeZones: All changes in zones I can access
set.webhooks.scopeHint: With “all changes” the receiver also gets other users’ changes – including user names and record contents.
set.webhooks.eventsLegacyHint: These filters come from an older version and match no known event. Remove them when you change the events – otherwise the server rejects the change.
set.webhooks.eventsNoneSelected: Please select at least one event.
set.webhooks.nameTooLong: The name may be at most {{max}} characters long.
set.webhooks.urlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
set.webhooks.secretRotatedTitle: New shared secret – shown only now
set.webhooks.secretBody: Store this secret at the receiver to verify the signature (X-DNS-Manager-Signature). It will not be shown again. Pending deliveries are signed with the current secret.
set.webhooks.drawerHint: Entries are kept for {{days}} days. Failed deliveries are retried up to {{max}} times with increasing delays (1 to 16 minutes).
set.webhooks.autoRefresh: Refreshing automatically while deliveries are pending
set.webhooks.retryConfirmSucceeded: This delivery already succeeded. Send it again anyway? The receiver gets the same delivery ID again.
set.webhooks.noDeliveries: No deliveries for this webhook yet.
set.webhooks.errorCode.url_unreadable: Target URL unreadable – please enter it again
